text: User correction 2026-09-12 supersedes earlier ownership framing: Eidolon is an early-stage idea and is not a current focus. This P3 proposal imposes no architecture, module retirement, migration or dependency requirement on ScalaFIM. Keep it dormant unless concrete native correctness/performance/API needs or an explicitly adopted consumer justify reopening implementation. Core ScalaFIM work and PHRF proceed independently. Historical ADR/RFE text is retained as proposal history, not binding authority. Sequential source assessment: WorkflowTypes still contains ArtifactLocation/WorkflowArtifactRef, but existing archive/estimates already provide reusable resource and pinned-identity boundaries. Any future consolidation should compare those native APIs and actual consumers before adding another descriptor family or removing live types. No foreign-adapter conformance is required for current native work.
